SRS-1.summary:
Verify Default state of Approval Level field
when the user is on the Create Session page
SRS-1.description:
Feature: Approval Level Initialization
The system controls default visibility of Approval Level fields.

Scenario: Default state of Approval Level field

Given the user is on the Create Session page
When the page loads
Then only the Add Level button should be visible and no Approval Level field should be displayed
SRS-1.acceptance:
Only the Add Level button should be visible and no Approval Level field should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the page loads.

SRS-1.summary:
Verify Display Approval Level field on Add Level click
when the user is on the Create Session page
SRS-1.description:
Feature: Dynamic Approval Level Addition
The system allows users to add approval levels dynamically.

Scenario: Display Approval Level field on Add Level click

Given the user is on the Create Session page
When the user clicks the Add Level button
Then a new Approval Level field should be displayed
SRS-1.acceptance:
A new Approval Level field should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Add Level button.

SRS-1.summary:
Verify Add approval levels up to maximum limit
when the user keeps clicking Add Level
SRS-1.description:
Feature: Approval Level Limit Control
The system restricts the number of approval levels.

Scenario: Add approval levels up to maximum limit

Given the user keeps clicking Add Level
When five Approval Level fields are added
Then the system should not allow adding more than 5 levels
SRS-1.acceptance:
The system should not allow adding more than 5 levels
The behavior should be validated when five Approval Level fields are added.

SRS-1.summary:
Verify Submit session with empty Approval Level fields
when one or more Approval Level fields are added
SRS-1.description:
Feature: Mandatory User Selection Validation
The system validates user selection in approval levels.

Scenario: Submit session with empty Approval Level fields

Given one or more Approval Level fields are added
And no user or group is selected in a level
When the user clicks Create Session
Then a toast message should be displayed saying:
“Error creating session: Each approval level must have at least one user selected”
SRS-1.acceptance:
A toast message should be displayed saying:
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Create Session.

SRS-1.summary:
Verify Select multiple users in a single approval level
when an Approval Level field is displayed
SRS-1.description:
Feature: Multiple User Selection per Level
The system supports assigning multiple users or groups per level.

Scenario: Select multiple users in a single approval level

Given an Approval Level field is displayed
When the user selects multiple users or user groups
Then all selected users or groups should be added successfully
SRS-1.acceptance:
All selected users or groups should be added successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user selects multiple users or user groups.

SRS-1.summary:
Verify Same user added individually and via group
when a user is already part of a selected user group
SRS-1.description:
Feature: Duplicate User Conflict Prevention (Individual vs Group)
The system prevents duplicate user assignments.

Scenario: Same user added individually and via group

Given a user is already part of a selected user group
When the same user is selected individually in the same level
Then the system should prevent the selection or show validation
SRS-1.acceptance:
The system should prevent the selection or show validation
The behavior should be validated when the same user is selected individually in the same level.

SRS-1.summary:
Verify User group added after individual user selection
when an individual user is already selected in a level
SRS-1.description:
Feature: Duplicate User Conflict Prevention (Group vs Individual)
The system enforces unique user assignment per level.

Scenario: User group added after individual user selection

Given an individual user is already selected in a level
When a group containing the same user is selected
Then the system should restrict the group selection or exclude the duplicate user
SRS-1.acceptance:
The system should restrict the group selection or exclude the duplicate user
The behavior should be validated when a group containing the same user is selected.

SRS-1.summary:
Verify Submit session with valid approval levels
when all Approval Levels have at least one unique user or group selected
SRS-1.description:
Feature: Approval Level Data Integrity
The system ensures each level has valid and unique users.

Scenario: Submit session with valid approval levels

Given all Approval Levels have at least one unique user or group selected
And no duplicate users exist across individual and group selections
When the user submits the session
Then the session should be created successfully
SRS-1.acceptance:
The session should be created successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user submits the session.

Scenario: Verify system blocks upload when JSON file is empty (0 KB)

Given the user is in the JSON Upload dialog
When the user selects an empty JSON file (size = 0 KB)
And clicks Upload
Then the system should reject the upload
And show toast message “The uploaded file is empty.”
SRS-208.acceptance:
The system should reject the upload
The behavior should be validated when the user selects an empty JSON file (size = 0 KB).

SRS-208.summary:
Verify system blocks upload when JSON parses successfully but contains no content
when the user selects a JSON file with content {}
SRS-208.description:
Feature: Empty File Validation – Reject Empty JSON Object

Scenario: Verify system blocks upload when JSON parses successfully but contains no content

Given the user selects a JSON file with content {}
or empty resource structure
When the user clicks Upload
Then the system should reject processing
And show toast message “The uploaded file is empty.”
SRS-208.acceptance:
The system should reject processing
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Upload.

SRS-209.summary:
Verify system blocks upload when required extracted resources are missing
when the user selects a valid JSON file
SRS-209.description:
Feature: Extracted Resources Validation – Reject Missing Resource Payload

Scenario: Verify system blocks upload when required extracted resources are missing

Given the user selects a valid JSON file
When the JSON does not contain required extracted resource keys/array
And clicks Upload
Then the system should reject processing
And show toast message “The uploaded file does not contain valid extracted resources.”
SRS-209.acceptance:
The system should reject processing
The behavior should be validated when the JSON does not contain required extracted resource keys/array.

SRS-209.summary:
Verify extracted resources error message is detailed and user-friendly
when the user uploads JSON without required extracted resources

Feature: Extracted Resources Validation – Message Clarity

Scenario: Verify extracted resources error message is detailed and user-friendly

Given the user uploads JSON without required extracted resources
When validation fails
Then the system should show a clear message describing missing core payload
And should not show technical schema errors
SRS-209.acceptance:
The system should show a clear message describing missing core payload
The behavior should be validated when validation fails.

SRS-210.summary:
Verify system shows error toast when storage upload fails
when the user selects a valid JSON file for upload
SRS-210.description:
Feature: Storage Upload Failure – Handle Network/Permission Error

Scenario: Verify system shows error toast when storage upload fails

Given the user selects a valid JSON file for upload
When the storage upload API fails due to network issue or permission denied
Then the system should stop upload process
And show toast message “Failed to upload file to storage. Please try again.”
SRS-210.acceptance:
The system should stop upload process
The behavior should be validated when the storage upload API fails due to network issue or permission denied.

SRS-210.summary:
Verify system provides retry option after upload failure
when the upload failed and error toast is shown
SRS-210.description:
Feature: Storage Upload Failure – Retry Option Available

Scenario: Verify system provides retry option after upload failure

Given the upload failed and error toast is shown
When the user clicks Retry button (if available)
Then the system should attempt upload again
And should not crash or freeze
SRS-210.acceptance:
The system should attempt upload again
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Retry button (if available).

SRS-211.summary:
Verify system shows error toast when browser fails to read file
when the user is in the JSON Upload dialog

And show toast message “Error reading file. Please check the file and try again.”
SRS-211.acceptance:

The behavior should be validated when the user selects a corrupt/locked file that triggers FileReader error.

SRS-211.acceptance:

SRS-212.summary:
Verify system blocks upload when JSON contains deprecated field labelIds
when the user selects a valid JSON file for upload

And clicks Upload
Then the system should reject the file
And show toast message File "[filename]": "labelIds". Please provide labels as "labels": [{ "id": "" }].

The system should reject the file
The behavior should be validated when the JSON contains the deprecated key "labelIds" anywhere in the payload.

Given the user uploads a JSON containing labelIds

And should clearly instruct to use labels object array instead
SRS-212.acceptance:
The toast should include the filename
The behavior should be validated when validation fails.

SRS-213.summary:
Verify system rejects upload when required childAnnotation is missing for taxonomy annotation
when the user selects a valid JSON file

The system should reject the file
The behavior should be validated when the JSON contains a taxonomy annotation type that requires childAnnotation.

And should not show technical schema dumps
SRS-213.acceptance:
The toast message should mention the specific annotationId causing the failure
The behavior should be validated when one annotation is missing childAnnotation.

when the S3 upload modal is open
SRS-247.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – S3 Key Validation

Scenario: Verify validation for invalid S3 key format

Given the S3 upload modal is open
When the user enters an incorrectly formatted S3 key
Then a validation message should be displayed
And upload should not proceed
SRS-247.acceptance:
A validation message should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user enters an incorrectly formatted S3 key.

SRS-247.summary:
Verify JSON file is fetched successfully using valid S3 key
when the user enters a valid S3 key
SRS-247.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Successful File Fetch

Scenario: Verify JSON file is fetched successfully using valid S3 key

Given the user enters a valid S3 key
When the user clicks the Upload button
Then the system should retrieve the JSON file from AWS S3
And validate the JSON structure successfully
SRS-247.acceptance:
The system should retrieve the JSON file from AWS S3
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Upload button.

SRS-247.summary:
Verify uploaded JSON file name is displayed
when the JSON file is uploaded successfully
SRS-247.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Uploaded File Display

Scenario: Verify uploaded JSON file name is displayed

Given the JSON file is uploaded successfully
When the upload completes
Then the JSON file name should be displayed below the upload area
And a Remove option should be available
SRS-247.acceptance:
The JSON file name should be displayed below the upload area
The behavior should be validated when the upload completes.

SRS-247.summary:
Verify uploaded JSON metadata is bound to session form
when the JSON file is uploaded successfully
SRS-247.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Bind File to Session State

Scenario: Verify uploaded JSON metadata is bound to session form

Given the JSON file is uploaded successfully
When the user continues session creation
Then the file metadata (name, size, reference path) should be stored in session state
SRS-247.acceptance:
The file metadata (name, size, reference path) should be stored in session state
The behavior should be validated when the user continues session creation.

SRS-247.summary:
Verify error handling when S3 file is not found or access denied
when the user enters a valid but inaccessible S3 key
SRS-247.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – File Not Found Handling

Scenario: Verify error handling when S3 file is not found or access denied

Given the user enters a valid but inaccessible S3 key
When the upload is attempted
Then a failure toast notification should be displayed
SRS-247.acceptance:
A failure toast notification should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the upload is attempted.

SRS-247.summary:
Verify invalid JSON structure is rejected
when the uploaded file is retrieved from S3
SRS-247.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Invalid JSON Structure

Scenario: Verify invalid JSON structure is rejected

Given the uploaded file is retrieved from S3
When the JSON structure validation fails
Then the system should reject the file
And display an appropriate error message without breaking the page
SRS-247.acceptance:
The system should reject the file
The behavior should be validated when the JSON structure validation fails.

SRS-247.summary:
Verify user can remove uploaded JSON file
when a JSON file is uploaded successfully
SRS-247.description:
Feature: Upload Link JSON from S3 – Remove Uploaded File

Scenario: Verify user can remove uploaded JSON file

Given a JSON file is uploaded successfully
When the user clicks the Remove option
Then the file should be removed from the UI
And session form state should be cleared of file data
SRS-247.acceptance:
The file should be removed from the UI
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Remove option.

SRS-247.summary:
Verify the expected behavior
under valid user actions
SRS-247.description: Verify large JSON file (>20MB) upload uses streaming without memory spikes
SRS-247.acceptance:
Expected result should be displayed as per the scenario.
System should not allow invalid behavior.

SRS-247.summary:
Verify the expected behavior
under valid user actions
SRS-247.description: Verify success notification is displayed immediately after successful upload or push
SRS-247.acceptance:
Expected result should be displayed as per the scenario.
System should not allow invalid behavior.

when the Upload from S3 button is visible
SRS-248.description:

SRS-248.acceptance:

SRS-248.summary:
Verify guidance text for Push to S3 button
when the Push to S3 button is visible
SRS-248.description:
Feature: S3 Upload & Push – Push Tooltip Content

When the user hovers over or focuses on the button
Then a tooltip should be displayed explaining the action purpose and outcome
SRS-248.acceptance:
A tooltip should be displayed explaining the action purpose and outcome
The behavior should be validated when the user hovers over or focuses on the button.

SRS-248.summary:
Verify tooltips are accessible via keyboard navigation
when the user navigates using the keyboard
SRS-248.description:
Feature: S3 Upload & Push – Tooltip Accessibility

Scenario: Verify tooltips are accessible via keyboard navigation

Given the user navigates using the keyboard
When focus is moved to Upload from S3 or Push to S3 buttons
Then the corresponding tooltip should be displayed
SRS-248.acceptance:
The corresponding tooltip should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when focus is moved to Upload from S3 or Push to S3 buttons.

SRS-248.summary:
Verify tooltip content loads instantly without delay
when the page containing S3 actions is loaded
SRS-248.description:
Feature: S3 Upload & Push – Instant Tooltip Availability

Scenario: Verify tooltip content loads instantly without delay

Given the page containing S3 actions is loaded
When the user hovers over the S3 action buttons
Then the tooltip should appear instantly without additional loading time
SRS-248.acceptance:
The tooltip should appear instantly without additional loading time
The behavior should be validated when the user hovers over the S3 action buttons.

SRS-249.summary:
Verify Copy Annotation button is disabled when image has no annotations
when the user selects an image with no existing annotations
SRS-249.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Default Disabled State

Scenario: Verify Copy Annotation button is disabled when image has no annotations

Given the user selects an image with no existing annotations
When the image is loaded
Then the Copy Annotation button should be disabled
SRS-249.acceptance:
The Copy Annotation button should be disabled
The behavior should be validated when the image is loaded.

SRS-249.summary:
Verify Copy Annotation button is enabled when image has annotations
when the user selects an image with at least one saved annotation
SRS-249.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Enabled State for Annotated Image

Scenario: Verify Copy Annotation button is enabled when image has annotations

Given the user selects an image with at least one saved annotation
When the image is loaded
Then the Copy Annotation button should be enabled
SRS-249.acceptance:
The Copy Annotation button should be enabled
The behavior should be validated when the image is loaded.

SRS-249.summary:
Verify Copy Annotation button becomes enabled after saving an annotation
when the user selects an image with no annotations
SRS-249.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Enable After Save

Scenario: Verify Copy Annotation button becomes enabled after saving an annotation

Given the user selects an image with no annotations
When the user adds and saves a new annotation
Then the Copy Annotation button should become enabled immediately
SRS-249.acceptance:
The Copy Annotation button should become enabled immediately
The behavior should be validated when the user adds and saves a new annotation.

SRS-249.summary:
Verify button state updates when switching between images
when the user switches between images with and without annotations
SRS-249.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Dynamic State Update on Image Change

Scenario: Verify button state updates when switching between images

Given the user switches between images with and without annotations
When a new image is selected
Then the Copy Annotation button state should update dynamically based on annotation presence
SRS-249.acceptance:
The Copy Annotation button state should update dynamically based on annotation presence
The behavior should be validated when a new image is selected.

SRS-249.summary:
Verify Copy Annotation action cannot be triggered when disabled
when the selected image has no annotations
SRS-249.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Disabled Action Protection

Scenario: Verify Copy Annotation action cannot be triggered when disabled

Given the selected image has no annotations
When the user attempts to click the disabled Copy Annotation button
Then no action should be triggered
SRS-249.acceptance:
No action should be triggered
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to click the disabled Copy Annotation button.

SRS-250.summary:
Verify keyboard shortcut is supported for copying annotations
when the user is viewing an image with saved annotations
SRS-250.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Shortcut Availability

Scenario: Verify keyboard shortcut is supported for copying annotations

Given the user is viewing an image with saved annotations
When the user presses Shift + Ctrl + Right Arrow
Then the system should initiate the copy annotations action
SRS-250.acceptance:
The system should initiate the copy annotations action
The behavior should be validated when the user presses Shift + Ctrl + Right Arrow.

SRS-250.summary:
Verify annotations are copied to the next image using shortcut
when the current image has one or more saved annotations
SRS-250.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Copy to Next Image via Shortcut

Scenario: Verify annotations are copied to the next image using shortcut

Given the current image has one or more saved annotations
When the user presses Shift + Ctrl + Right Arrow
Then all saved annotations should be copied to the next image
SRS-250.acceptance:
All saved annotations should be copied to the next image
The behavior should be validated when the user presses Shift + Ctrl + Right Arrow.

SRS-250.summary:
Verify Copy Annotation button triggers manual copy flow
when the Copy Annotation button is enabled
SRS-250.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Manual Copy Option

Scenario: Verify Copy Annotation button triggers manual copy flow

Given the Copy Annotation button is enabled
When the user clicks the Copy Annotation button
Then the system should open the image selection popup
SRS-250.acceptance:
The system should open the image selection popup
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Copy Annotation button.

SRS-250.summary:
Verify annotations are copied to selected image via manual option
when the image selection popup is displayed
SRS-250.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Manual Target Image Selection

Scenario: Verify annotations are copied to selected image via manual option

Given the image selection popup is displayed
When the user selects a target image and confirms
Then all saved annotations should be copied to the selected image
SRS-250.acceptance:
All saved annotations should be copied to the selected image
The behavior should be validated when the user selects a target image and confirms.

SRS-250.summary:
Verify confirmation message after successful copy
when annotations are copied successfully
SRS-250.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Success Confirmation Message

Scenario: Verify confirmation message after successful copy

Given annotations are copied successfully
When the copy operation completes
Then a confirmation message such as “Annotations copied to image XX” should be displayed
SRS-250.acceptance:
A confirmation message such as "Annotations copied to image XX" should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the copy operation completes.

SRS-250.summary:
Verify copy is blocked when unsaved annotations exist
when the current image has unsaved annotations
SRS-250.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Unsaved Annotation Restriction

Scenario: Verify copy is blocked when unsaved annotations exist

Given the current image has unsaved annotations
When the user attempts to copy annotations using shortcut or button
Then the copy action should be blocked
And an error message “Cannot copy annotations: Please save your annotations first” should be displayed
SRS-250.acceptance:
The copy action should be blocked
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to copy annotations using shortcut or button.

SRS-250.summary:
Verify target image view updates after copy
when annotations are copied to a target image
SRS-250.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Target Image Update

Scenario: Verify target image view updates after copy

Given annotations are copied to a target image
When the target image is opened
Then the copied annotations should be visible and editable
SRS-250.acceptance:
The copied annotations should be visible and editable
The behavior should be validated when the target image is opened.

SRS-251.summary:
Verify keyboard shortcut is supported for copying annotations to previous image
when the user is viewing an image with saved annotations
SRS-251.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Previous Image Shortcut Availability

Scenario: Verify keyboard shortcut is supported for copying annotations to previous image

Given the user is viewing an image with saved annotations
When the user presses Shift + Ctrl + Left Arrow
Then the system should initiate the copy annotations action to the previous image
SRS-251.acceptance:
The system should initiate the copy annotations action to the previous image
The behavior should be validated when the user presses Shift + Ctrl + Left Arrow.

SRS-251.summary:
Verify annotations are copied to the previous image using shortcut
when the current image has one or more saved annotations
SRS-251.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Copy to Previous Image via Shortcut

Scenario: Verify annotations are copied to the previous image using shortcut

Given the current image has one or more saved annotations
When the user presses Shift + Ctrl + Left Arrow
Then all saved annotations should be copied to the previous image
SRS-251.acceptance:
All saved annotations should be copied to the previous image
The behavior should be validated when the user presses Shift + Ctrl + Left Arrow.

SRS-251.summary:
Verify manual copy flow allows selecting a previous image
when the Copy Annotation button is enabled
SRS-251.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Manual Copy Option to Previous Image

Scenario: Verify manual copy flow allows selecting a previous image

Given the Copy Annotation button is enabled
When the user clicks the Copy Annotation button
Then the “Select an image to copy annotations to” popup should be displayed with previous image options
SRS-251.acceptance:
The "Select an image to copy annotations to" popup should be displayed with previous image options
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Copy Annotation button.

SRS-251.summary:
Verify annotations are copied to selected previous image via manual option
when the image selection popup is displayed
SRS-251.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Manual Target Selection to Previous Image

Scenario: Verify annotations are copied to selected previous image via manual option

Given the image selection popup is displayed
When the user selects a previous image and confirms
Then all saved annotations should be copied to the selected previous image
SRS-251.acceptance:
All saved annotations should be copied to the selected previous image
The behavior should be validated when the user selects a previous image and confirms.

SRS-251.summary:
Verify confirmation message after successful copy to previous image
when annotations are copied successfully to a previous image
SRS-251.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Success Confirmation Message (Previous Image)

Scenario: Verify confirmation message after successful copy to previous image

Given annotations are copied successfully to a previous image
When the copy operation completes
Then a confirmation message such as “Annotations copied to image XX” should be displayed
SRS-251.acceptance:
A confirmation message such as "Annotations copied to image XX" should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the copy operation completes.

SRS-251.summary:
Verify copy is blocked when unsaved annotations exist
when the current image has unsaved annotations
SRS-251.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Unsaved Annotation Restriction (Previous Image)

Scenario: Verify copy is blocked when unsaved annotations exist

Given the current image has unsaved annotations
When the user attempts to copy annotations to a previous image using shortcut or button
Then the copy action should be blocked
And an error message “Cannot copy annotations: Please save your annotations first. You have X unsaved annotation(s).” should be displayed
SRS-251.acceptance:
The copy action should be blocked
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to copy annotations to a previous image using shortcut or button.

SRS-251.summary:
Verify previous image view refreshes after copy
when annotations are copied to a previous image
SRS-251.description:
Feature: Copy Annotations – Target Image Refresh

Scenario: Verify previous image view refreshes after copy

Given annotations are copied to a previous image
When the previous image is opened
Then the copied annotations should be visible and editable
SRS-251.acceptance:
The copied annotations should be visible and editable
The behavior should be validated when the previous image is opened.

SRS-252.summary:
Verify conflict popup appears when copying to next image with existing annotations
when the source image has saved annotations
SRS-252.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Conflict Detection on Next Image

Scenario: Verify conflict popup appears when copying to next image with existing annotations

Given the source image has saved annotations
And the next image already contains annotations
When the user copies annotations to the next image
Then the “Existing Annotations Found” popup should be displayed
SRS-252.acceptance:
The "Existing Annotations Found" popup should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user copies annotations to the next image.

SRS-252.summary:
Verify conflict popup appears when copying to previous image with existing annotations
when the source image has saved annotations
SRS-252.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Conflict Detection on Previous Image

Scenario: Verify conflict popup appears when copying to previous image with existing annotations

Given the source image has saved annotations
And the previous image already contains annotations
When the user copies annotations to the previous image
Then the “Existing Annotations Found” popup should be displayed
SRS-252.acceptance:
The "Existing Annotations Found" popup should be displayed
The behavior should be validated when the user copies annotations to the previous image.

SRS-252.summary:
Verify background is blocked when conflict popup is displayed
when the "Existing Annotations Found" popup is open
SRS-252.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Background Interaction Block

Scenario: Verify background is blocked when conflict popup is displayed

Given the “Existing Annotations Found” popup is open
When the user attempts to interact with the background image or controls
Then no background interaction should be allowed until popup action is taken
SRS-252.acceptance:
No background interaction should be allowed until popup action is taken
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to interact with the background image or controls.

SRS-252.summary:
Verify old annotations are fully removed before copy
when the target image contains existing annotations
SRS-252.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – Replace Overwrite Validation

Scenario: Verify old annotations are fully removed before copy

Given the target image contains existing annotations
When the user selects Replace in the conflict popup
Then all existing annotations should be removed
And only copied annotations should be present
SRS-252.acceptance:
All existing annotations should be removed
The behavior should be validated when the user selects Replace in the conflict popup.

SRS-252.summary:
Verify partial replacement does not occur
when the conflict popup is displayed
SRS-252.description:
Feature: Copy Annotation – No Partial Replace

Scenario: Verify partial replacement does not occur

Given the conflict popup is displayed
When the user selects Replace
Then the system should not retain any previous annotations on the target image
SRS-252.acceptance:
The system should not retain any previous annotations on the target image
The behavior should be validated when the user selects Replace.

SRS-253.summary:
Verify Lock icon is visible when Lock permission is enabled in role
when the admin enables "Lock" permission in Masters â†’ User Roles â†’ Session for the logged-in user role
SRS-253.description:
Feature: Session Lock Permission – Lock Icon Visible

Scenario: Verify Lock icon is visible when Lock permission is enabled in role

Given the admin enables “Lock” permission in Masters → User Roles → Session for the logged-in user role
When the user navigates to Data Labelling Session list page
Then Lock icon should be visible in Actions column for sessions
SRS-253.acceptance:
Lock icon should be visible in Actions column for sessions
The behavior should be validated when the user navigates to Data Labelling Session list page.

SRS-253.summary:
Verify Lock icon is hidden when Lock permission is disabled in role
when the admin disables "Lock" permission in Masters â†’ User Roles â†’ Session for the logged-in user role
SRS-253.description:
Feature: Session Lock Permission – Lock Icon Hidden

Scenario: Verify Lock icon is hidden when Lock permission is disabled in role

Given the admin disables “Lock” permission in Masters → User Roles → Session for the logged-in user role
When the user navigates to Data Labelling Session list page
Then Lock icon should not be visible in Actions column
SRS-253.acceptance:
Lock icon should not be visible in Actions column
The behavior should be validated when the user navigates to Data Labelling Session list page.

SRS-253.summary:
Verify unauthorized user cannot access Lock Session popup
when the user role does not have Lock permission enabled
SRS-253.description:
Feature: Session Lock Permission – Cannot Open Lock Popup Without Permission

Scenario: Verify unauthorized user cannot access Lock Session popup

Given the user role does not have Lock permission enabled
When the user attempts to lock a session (directly via UI or shortcut)
Then the system should block the action
And Lock Session popup should not be accessible
SRS-253.acceptance:
The system should block the action
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to lock a session (directly via UI or shortcut).

SRS-253.summary:
Verify Lock icon visibility updates after permission change
when the user is logged in with a role where Lock permission is disabled
SRS-253.description:
Feature: Session Lock Permission – Permission Change Reflects Immediately

Scenario: Verify Lock icon visibility updates after permission change

Given the user is logged in with a role where Lock permission is disabled
When admin enables Lock permission for that role
And user refreshes or re-login to application
Then Lock icon should appear in Actions column
SRS-253.acceptance:
Lock icon should appear in Actions column
The behavior should be validated when admin enables Lock permission for that role.

SRS-253.summary:
Verify lock action is rejected even if API is triggered without permission
when the user does not have Lock permission
SRS-253.description:
Feature: Session Lock Permission – Backend Restriction

Scenario: Verify lock action is rejected even if API is triggered without permission

Given the user does not have Lock permission
When the user tries to perform lock action through direct request (bypass UI)
Then the system should deny the request
And session should not be locked
SRS-253.acceptance:
The system should deny the request
The behavior should be validated when the user tries to perform lock action through direct request (bypass UI).

SRS-253.summary:
Verify Unlock action is visible only if Lock permission exists
when the user role has Lock permission enabled
SRS-253.description:
Feature: Session Lock Permission – Unlock Visible Only With Permission

Scenario: Verify Unlock action is visible only if Lock permission exists

Given the user role has Lock permission enabled
And the session is already locked
When the session list page is displayed
Then Unlock icon/action should be visible for locked session
SRS-253.acceptance:
Unlock icon/action should be visible for locked session
The behavior should be validated when the session list page is displayed.

SRS-253.summary:
Verify Unlock action is hidden when Lock permission is removed
when a session is locked
SRS-253.description:
Feature: Session Lock Permission – Unlock Hidden Without Permission

Scenario: Verify Unlock action is hidden when Lock permission is removed

Given a session is locked
And the admin removes Lock permission from the user role
When the user opens the session list page
Then Unlock icon should not be visible
SRS-253.acceptance:
Unlock icon should not be visible
The behavior should be validated when the user opens the session list page.

SRS-253.summary:
Verify unauthorized user cannot unlock a locked session
when a session is locked
SRS-253.description:
Feature: Session Lock Permission – Prevent Unlock Without Permission

Scenario: Verify unauthorized user cannot unlock a locked session

Given a session is locked
And the user does not have Lock permission enabled
When the user attempts to unlock the session
Then the system should block unlock action
And session should remain locked
SRS-253.acceptance:
The system should block unlock action
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to unlock the session.

SRS-253.summary:
Verify authorized user can lock and unlock session successfully
when the user role has Lock permission enabled
SRS-253.description:
Feature: Session Lock Permission – Lock/Unlock Works for Authorized Role

Scenario: Verify authorized user can lock and unlock session successfully

Given the user role has Lock permission enabled
When user locks a session by providing reason
And user unlocks the same session by providing reason
Then both actions should be completed successfully
SRS-253.acceptance:
Both actions should be completed successfully
The behavior should be validated when user locks a session by providing reason.

SRS-253.summary:
Verify lock controls are fully hidden when permission is not granted
when Lock permission is disabled for the role
SRS-253.description:
Feature: Session Lock Permission – No Partial Visibility

Scenario: Verify lock controls are fully hidden when permission is not granted

Given Lock permission is disabled for the role
When the user opens session list page
Then lock-related icons should not appear anywhere (Actions / menu / tooltip)
SRS-253.acceptance:
Lock-related icons should not appear anywhere (Actions / menu / tooltip)
The behavior should be validated when the user opens session list page.

SRS-254.summary:
Verify lock icon is displayed when session status is Completed
when the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
SRS-254.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Visible for Completed Session

Scenario: Verify lock icon is displayed when session status is Completed

Given the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
And a session status is set to Completed
When the grid is displayed/refreshed
Then the Lock icon should be visible for that Completed session row
SRS-254.acceptance:
The Lock icon should be visible for that Completed session row
The behavior should be validated when the grid is displayed/refreshed.

SRS-254.summary:
Verify lock icon is not shown when session status is Yet to do
when the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
SRS-254.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Not Visible for Yet to do Session

Scenario: Verify lock icon is not shown when session status is Yet to do

Given the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
When a session status is Yet to do
Then the Lock icon should not be displayed for that session row
SRS-254.acceptance:
The Lock icon should not be displayed for that session row
The behavior should be validated when a session status is Yet to do.

SRS-254.summary:
Verify lock icon is not shown when session status is In progress
when the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
SRS-254.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Not Visible for In progress Session

Scenario: Verify lock icon is not shown when session status is In progress

Given the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
When a session status is In progress
Then the Lock icon should not be displayed for that session row
SRS-254.acceptance:
The Lock icon should not be displayed for that session row
The behavior should be validated when a session status is In progress.

SRS-254.summary:
Verify lock icon appears after session status is updated to Completed
when the session status is not Completed initially
SRS-254.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Appears After Status Change to Completed

Scenario: Verify lock icon appears after session status is updated to Completed

Given the session status is not Completed initially
When the session status is changed to Completed
And the user returns to session list page / refreshes grid
Then the Lock icon should appear for that session row
SRS-254.acceptance:
The Lock icon should appear for that session row
The behavior should be validated when the session status is changed to Completed.

SRS-254.summary:
Verify lock icon disappears if session status is changed from Completed to other status
when the session status is Completed and Lock icon is visible
SRS-254.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Removed When Status Changes from Completed

Scenario: Verify lock icon disappears if session status is changed from Completed to other status

Given the session status is Completed and Lock icon is visible
When the session status changes to Re-open / In progress / Yet to do
Then the Lock icon should no longer be displayed for that session row
SRS-254.acceptance:
The Lock icon should no longer be displayed for that session row
The behavior should be validated when the session status changes to Re-open / In progress / Yet to do.

SRS-255.summary:
Verify Lock confirmation popup opens on clicking Lock icon
when the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
SRS-255.description:
Feature: Lock Session – Popup Open

Scenario: Verify Lock confirmation popup opens on clicking Lock icon

Given the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
And a session status is Completed
When the user clicks the Lock icon
Then the Lock popup should open with Reason textbox and Submit/Cancel buttons
SRS-255.acceptance:
The Lock popup should open with Reason textbox and Submit/Cancel buttons
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the Lock icon.

SRS-255.summary:
Verify submission is blocked if reason is empty
when Lock popup is opened
SRS-255.description:
Feature: Lock Session – Reason Mandatory

Scenario: Verify submission is blocked if reason is empty

Given Lock popup is opened
When the user keeps Reason field empty
And clicks Submit
Then the system should block submission
And mandatory validation should be shown for Reason
SRS-255.acceptance:
The system should block submission
The behavior should be validated when the user keeps Reason field empty.

SRS-255.summary:
Verify session is locked when valid reason is entered
when Lock popup is opened
SRS-255.description:
Feature: Lock Session – Lock Success with Valid Reason

Scenario: Verify session is locked when valid reason is entered

Given Lock popup is opened
When the user enters a valid reason (Ex:For testing lock)
And clicks Submit
Then the session should be locked successfully
And lock state should be applied in UI
SRS-255.acceptance:
The session should be locked successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user enters a valid reason (Ex:For testing lock).

SRS-255.summary:
Verify session is not locked when user cancels popup
when Lock popup is opened
SRS-255.description:
Feature: Lock Session – Cancel Does Not Lock Session

Scenario: Verify session is not locked when user cancels popup

Given Lock popup is opened
When the user enters a reason
And clicks Cancel
Then the popup should close
And session should remain unlocked
SRS-255.acceptance:
The popup should close
The behavior should be validated when the user enters a reason.

SRS-255.summary:
Verify lock reason is stored and visible as tooltip after locking
when the session is locked using a reason
SRS-255.description:
Feature: Lock Session – Reason Stored for Audit

Scenario: Verify lock reason is stored and visible as tooltip after locking

Given the session is locked using a reason
When the user hovers over lock indicator/icon in session list
Then the tooltip should show “Session is locked. Reason: <entered reason>”
SRS-255.acceptance:
The tooltip should show "Session is locked. Reason: <entered reason>"
The behavior should be validated when the user hovers over lock indicator/icon in session list.

SRS-256.summary:
Verify Edit is disabled/hidden when session is locked
when a session is locked successfully
SRS-256.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Edit Action Disabled

Scenario: Verify Edit is disabled/hidden when session is locked

Given a session is locked successfully
When the user views Actions column for that session
Then Edit option should be disabled or hidden
SRS-256.acceptance:
Edit option should be disabled or hidden
The behavior should be validated when the user views Actions column for that session.

SRS-256.summary:
Verify Delete is disabled/hidden when session is locked
when a session is locked successfully
SRS-256.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Delete Action Disabled

Scenario: Verify Delete is disabled/hidden when session is locked

Given a session is locked successfully
When the user views Actions column for that session
Then Delete option should be disabled or hidden
SRS-256.acceptance:
Delete option should be disabled or hidden
The behavior should be validated when the user views Actions column for that session.

SRS-256.summary:
Verify Duplicate action remains enabled for locked session
when a session is locked successfully
SRS-256.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Duplicate Allowed

Scenario: Verify Duplicate action remains enabled for locked session

Given a session is locked successfully
When the user views Actions column for that session
Then Duplicate option should remain enabled and clickable
SRS-256.acceptance:
Duplicate option should remain enabled and clickable
The behavior should be validated when the user views Actions column for that session.

SRS-256.summary:
Verify user can duplicate a locked session successfully
when a session is locked
SRS-256.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Duplicate Creates New Session

Scenario: Verify user can duplicate a locked session successfully

Given a session is locked
When the user clicks Duplicate
And enters a new valid session name
And submits
Then the system should create a new session successfully
SRS-256.acceptance:
The system should create a new session successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Duplicate.

SRS-256.summary:
Verify direct API edit request is rejected for locked session
when the session is locked
SRS-256.description:
Feature: Locked Session – API Blocks Edit

Scenario: Verify direct API edit request is rejected for locked session

Given the session is locked
When the user attempts to edit session using direct request/API call
Then the system should reject the request
And session data should remain unchanged
SRS-256.acceptance:
The system should reject the request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to edit session using direct request/API call.

SRS-256.summary:
Verify direct API delete request is rejected for locked session
when the session is locked
SRS-256.description:
Feature: Locked Session – API Blocks Delete

Scenario: Verify direct API delete request is rejected for locked session

Given the session is locked
When the user attempts to delete session using direct request/API call
Then the system should reject the request
And session should not be deleted
SRS-256.acceptance:
The system should reject the request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to delete session using direct request/API call.

SRS-256.summary:
Verify Edit/Delete available when session is unlocked
when a session is not locked
SRS-256.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Normal Actions for Unlocked Session

Scenario: Verify Edit/Delete available when session is unlocked

Given a session is not locked
When the user views Actions column
Then Edit and Delete options should be enabled normally
SRS-256.acceptance:
Edit and Delete options should be enabled normally
The behavior should be validated when the user views Actions column.

SRS-256.summary:
Verify locked session cannot be edited via direct URL navigation
when the session is locked
SRS-256.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Prevent Access to Edit Screen via URL

Scenario: Verify locked session cannot be edited via direct URL navigation

Given the session is locked
When the user tries to open Edit Session page via direct URL
Then the system should block access
And show safe message or redirect back
SRS-256.acceptance:
The system should block access
The behavior should be validated when the user tries to open Edit Session page via direct URL.

SRS-257.summary:
Verify Unlock icon is visible for locked session
when a session is locked successfully
SRS-257.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Unlock Icon Visibility

Scenario: Verify Unlock icon is visible for locked session

Given a session is locked successfully
When the session list page is displayed
Then Unlock icon should be visible for that locked session row
SRS-257.acceptance:
Unlock icon should be visible for that locked session row
The behavior should be validated when the session list page is displayed.

SRS-257.summary:
Verify Unlock popup opens on clicking unlock icon
when the session is locked
SRS-257.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Popup Open

Scenario: Verify Unlock popup opens on clicking unlock icon

Given the session is locked
When the user clicks Unlock icon
Then Unlock popup should open with Reason textbox and Submit/Cancel buttons
SRS-257.acceptance:
Unlock popup should open with Reason textbox and Submit/Cancel buttons
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks Unlock icon.

SRS-257.summary:
Verify unlock submission is blocked if reason is empty
when Unlock popup is opened
SRS-257.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Reason Mandatory Validation

Scenario: Verify unlock submission is blocked if reason is empty

Given Unlock popup is opened
When the user keeps Reason field empty
And clicks Submit
Then the system should block unlock action
And mandatory validation should be shown
SRS-257.acceptance:
The system should block unlock action
The behavior should be validated when the user keeps Reason field empty.

SRS-257.summary:
Verify session unlocks successfully with valid reason
when Unlock popup is opened
SRS-257.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Successful Unlock

Scenario: Verify session unlocks successfully with valid reason

Given Unlock popup is opened
When the user enters a valid unlock reason
And clicks Submit
Then the session should be unlocked successfully
And session state should change to Re-open
SRS-257.acceptance:
The session should be unlocked successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user enters a valid unlock reason.

SRS-257.summary:
Verify Edit/Delete actions are enabled after session unlock
when the session was locked and then unlocked successfully
SRS-257.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Actions Enabled After Unlock

Scenario: Verify Edit/Delete actions are enabled after session unlock

Given the session was locked and then unlocked successfully
When the user views Actions column for that session
Then Edit and Delete actions should become enabled
SRS-257.acceptance:
Edit and Delete actions should become enabled
The behavior should be validated when the user views Actions column for that session.

SRS-257.summary:
Verify session remains locked when user cancels unlock popup
when Unlock popup is opened
SRS-257.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Cancel Does Not Unlock Session

Scenario: Verify session remains locked when user cancels unlock popup

Given Unlock popup is opened
When the user enters a reason
And clicks Cancel
Then the popup should close
And the session should remain locked
SRS-257.acceptance:
The popup should close
The behavior should be validated when the user enters a reason.

SRS-257.summary:
Verify unauthorized user cannot unlock session
when a session is locked
SRS-257.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Only Authorized Users Can Unlock

Scenario: Verify unauthorized user cannot unlock session

Given a session is locked
And the logged-in user does not have Lock permission
When the user tries to unlock the session
Then the system should block the unlock action
And session should remain locked
SRS-257.acceptance:
The system should block the unlock action
The behavior should be validated when the user tries to unlock the session.

SRS-257.summary:
Verify unlock reason is stored for audit and visible in history/tooltip if available
when the session is unlocked with a reason
SRS-257.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Unlock Reason Stored

Scenario: Verify unlock reason is stored for audit and visible in history/tooltip if available

Given the session is unlocked with a reason
When the user checks lock/unlock info (tooltip/log if available)
Then the unlock reason should be recorded correctly
SRS-257.acceptance:
The unlock reason should be recorded correctly
The behavior should be validated when the user checks lock/unlock info (tooltip/log if available).

SRS-258.summary:
Verify lock icon is visible but disabled when user belongs to group but lacks lock permission
when the user is assigned to the project/session group
SRS-258.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Disabled Without Lock Permission

Scenario: Verify lock icon is visible but disabled when user belongs to group but lacks lock permission

Given the user is assigned to the project/session group
And the user role does not have Lock permission enabled
When the user opens Data Labelling Session list page
Then the Lock icon should be visible
And it should be greyed out and non-clickable
SRS-258.acceptance:
The Lock icon should be visible
The behavior should be validated when the user opens Data Labelling Session list page.

SRS-258.summary:
Verify clicking disabled lock icon does not open popup
when lock icon is displayed in disabled state
SRS-258.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Click Ignored in Disabled State

Scenario: Verify clicking disabled lock icon does not open popup

Given lock icon is displayed in disabled state
When the user clicks the disabled Lock icon
Then Lock popup should not open
And no action should be performed
SRS-258.acceptance:
Lock popup should not open
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the disabled Lock icon.

SRS-258.summary:
Verify tooltip message indicates permission missing
when lock icon is disabled
SRS-258.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Tooltip for Disabled State (If Available)

Scenario: Verify tooltip message indicates permission missing

Given lock icon is disabled
When the user hovers over the lock icon
Then tooltip should indicate lock permission is required (if tooltip is implemented)
SRS-258.acceptance:
Tooltip should indicate lock permission is required (if tooltip is implemented)
The behavior should be validated when the user hovers over the lock icon.

SRS-258.summary:
Verify disabled lock icon becomes enabled after Lock permission is granted
when the user is in the group but lock permission is disabled initially
SRS-258.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Enabled After Permission Granted

Scenario: Verify disabled lock icon becomes enabled after Lock permission is granted

Given the user is in the group but lock permission is disabled initially
When admin enables Lock permission for the user role
And the user refreshes or re-login
Then the lock icon should become enabled and clickable
SRS-258.acceptance:
The lock icon should become enabled and clickable
The behavior should be validated when admin enables Lock permission for the user role.

SRS-258.summary:
Verify user cannot lock session via API even if icon is visible disabled
when the user belongs to the group but lacks Lock permission
SRS-258.description:
Feature: Lock Action – Blocked Without Permission Even If Visible

Scenario: Verify user cannot lock session via API even if icon is visible disabled

Given the user belongs to the group but lacks Lock permission
When the user attempts lock action through direct request/API call
Then the system should reject the request
And session should remain unlocked
SRS-258.acceptance:
The system should reject the request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts lock action through direct request/API call.

SRS-259.summary:
Verify backend rejects update request for locked session
when a session is locked successfully
SRS-259.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Backend Blocks Edit API

Scenario: Verify backend rejects update request for locked session

Given a session is locked successfully
When the user attempts to update session details using direct request/API (bypass UI)
Then the system should reject the request
And return access denied response
SRS-259.acceptance:
The system should reject the request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to update session details using direct request/API (bypass UI).

SRS-259.summary:
Verify backend rejects delete request for locked session
when a session is locked successfully
SRS-259.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Backend Blocks Delete API

Scenario: Verify backend rejects delete request for locked session

Given a session is locked successfully
When the user attempts to delete session using direct request/API call
Then the system should reject the request
And return access denied response
SRS-259.acceptance:
The system should reject the request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to delete session using direct request/API call.

SRS-259.summary:
Verify backend rejects session status update when session is locked
when a session is locked
SRS-259.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Backend Blocks Status Change

Scenario: Verify backend rejects session status update when session is locked

Given a session is locked
When the user attempts to change session status through API (Completed → Re-open / In progress)
Then the system should reject the request
And session status should remain unchanged
SRS-259.acceptance:
The system should reject the request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to change session status through API (Completed â†’ Re-open / In progress).

SRS-259.summary:
Verify backend blocks updates to session configuration fields when locked
when a session is locked successfully
SRS-259.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Backend Blocks Configuration Update

Scenario: Verify backend blocks updates to session configuration fields when locked

Given a session is locked successfully
When the user attempts to update session config fields (labels, assignees, reviewers, approval levels) using API
Then the system should reject the update request
And no changes should be saved
SRS-259.acceptance:
The system should reject the update request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to update session config fields (labels, assignees, reviewers, approval levels) using API.

SRS-259.summary:
Verify backend allows creating a new duplicated session while original is locked
when the original session is locked
SRS-259.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Backend Allows Duplicate Creation Only

Scenario: Verify backend allows creating a new duplicated session while original is locked

Given the original session is locked
When the user duplicates the session (new session creation request)
Then the system should allow duplication
And create a new session record successfully
SRS-259.acceptance:
The system should allow duplication
The behavior should be validated when the user duplicates the session (new session creation request).

SRS-259.summary:
Verify access denied response is safe and non-technical
when a session is locked
SRS-259.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Access Denied Message Non-Technical

Scenario: Verify access denied response is safe and non-technical

Given a session is locked
When the user triggers a blocked update request
Then the system should return access denied response
And it should not expose internal server or stack details
SRS-259.acceptance:
The system should return access denied response
The behavior should be validated when the user triggers a blocked update request.

SRS-260.summary:
Verify session lock completes without noticeable delay
when the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
SRS-260.description:
Feature: Lock Action – Quick Completion

Scenario: Verify session lock completes without noticeable delay

Given the user is on Data Labelling Session list page
When the user locks a Completed session with valid reason
Then the lock action should complete quickly
And lock state should reflect immediately in grid
SRS-260.acceptance:
The lock action should complete quickly
The behavior should be validated when the user locks a Completed session with valid reason.

SRS-260.summary:
Verify session unlock completes without noticeable delay
when a session is locked
SRS-260.description:
Feature: Unlock Action – Quick Completion

Scenario: Verify session unlock completes without noticeable delay

Given a session is locked
When the user unlocks the session with valid reason
Then the unlock action should complete quickly
And session status should update to Re-open instantly
SRS-260.acceptance:
The unlock action should complete quickly
The behavior should be validated when the user unlocks the session with valid reason.

SRS-260.summary:
Verify loader is shown during lock/unlock processing
when the user triggers Lock or Unlock action
SRS-260.description:
Feature: Lock/Unlock – Loader Visibility

Scenario: Verify loader is shown during lock/unlock processing

Given the user triggers Lock or Unlock action
When the system processes the request
Then a loader/processing indicator should be shown until completion
SRS-260.acceptance:
A loader/processing indicator should be shown until completion
The behavior should be validated when the system processes the request.

SRS-260.summary:
Verify grid refresh happens instantly without full page reload
when the session list page is open
SRS-260.description:
Feature: Lock Action – Grid Refresh Without Full Page Reload

Scenario: Verify grid refresh happens instantly without full page reload

Given the session list page is open
When the user locks a session
Then the grid should refresh immediately
And the page should not fully reload
SRS-260.acceptance:
The grid should refresh immediately
The behavior should be validated when the user locks a session.

SRS-260.summary:
Verify retry option/message appears when lock action times out
when the user triggers lock/unlock action
SRS-260.description:
Feature: Lock/Unlock Timeout Retry Handling

Scenario: Verify retry option/message appears when lock action times out

Given the user triggers lock/unlock action
When the request times out due to slow network/backend delay
Then the system should show retry option or timeout message
And user should be able to retry without breaking UI
SRS-260.acceptance:
The system should show retry option or timeout message
The behavior should be validated when the request times out due to slow network/backend delay.

SRS-261.summary:
Verify locked session is clearly identifiable in session list
when a session is locked successfully
SRS-261.description:
Feature: Lock Status – Visual Indicator Visible

Scenario: Verify locked session is clearly identifiable in session list

Given a session is locked successfully
When the session list page is displayed
Then a lock icon/badge should be clearly visible for the locked session
SRS-261.acceptance:
A lock icon/badge should be clearly visible for the locked session
The behavior should be validated when the session list page is displayed.

SRS-261.summary:
Verify lock indicator is removed after unlocking session
when a session was locked and then unlocked
SRS-261.description:
Feature: Unlock Status – Visual Indicator Removed

Scenario: Verify lock indicator is removed after unlocking session

Given a session was locked and then unlocked
When the session list refreshes
Then the lock icon/badge should no longer be visible
SRS-261.acceptance:
The lock icon/badge should no longer be visible
The behavior should be validated when the session list refreshes.

SRS-261.summary:
Verify tooltip displays lock reason clearly
when a session is locked with a reason
SRS-261.description:
Feature: Lock Status – Tooltip Shows Reason

Scenario: Verify tooltip displays lock reason clearly

Given a session is locked with a reason
When the user hovers over the lock icon/badge
Then the tooltip should display “Session is locked. Reason: <reason>”
SRS-261.acceptance:
The tooltip should display "Session is locked. Reason: <reason>"
The behavior should be validated when the user hovers over the lock icon/badge.

SRS-261.summary:
Verify disabled actions are visually distinguishable for locked session
when a session is locked
SRS-261.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Disabled Actions Visually Distinct

Scenario: Verify disabled actions are visually distinguishable for locked session

Given a session is locked
When the user views Edit/Delete actions
Then disabled actions should appear greyed out or hidden
And clearly indicate non-interactive state
SRS-261.acceptance:
Disabled actions should appear greyed out or hidden
The behavior should be validated when the user views Edit/Delete actions.

SRS-261.summary:
Verify Duplicate action is clearly available even when session is locked
when a session is locked
SRS-261.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Duplicate Action Clearly Available

Scenario: Verify Duplicate action is clearly available even when session is locked

Given a session is locked
When the user views Actions column
Then Duplicate option should remain clearly enabled and usable
SRS-261.acceptance:
Duplicate option should remain clearly enabled and usable
The behavior should be validated when the user views Actions column.

SRS-261.summary:
Verify lock indicators remain clear after refresh or re-login
when a session is locked
SRS-261.description:
Feature: Lock Status – Consistent Indicators Across Refresh

Scenario: Verify lock indicators remain clear after refresh or re-login

Given a session is locked
When the user refreshes the page or logs out and logs in again
Then the lock icon/badge and tooltip should still display correctly
SRS-261.acceptance:
The lock icon/badge and tooltip should still display correctly
The behavior should be validated when the user refreshes the page or logs out and logs in again.

SRS-261.summary:
Verify lock/unlock indicators do not confuse users
when multiple sessions exist (locked and unlocked)
SRS-261.description:
Feature: Lock Status – No Ambiguous Messaging

Scenario: Verify lock/unlock indicators do not confuse users

Given multiple sessions exist (locked and unlocked)
When the user scans the session list
Then locked and unlocked sessions should be clearly distinguishable at a glance
SRS-261.acceptance:
Locked and unlocked sessions should be clearly distinguishable at a glance
The behavior should be validated when the user scans the session list.
